identity.name: TRANSRAILL
identity.industry: Power T&D EPC (Transmission & Distribution turnkey + tower/conductor manufacturing)

summary.oneLiner: Best-ever year (rev +30%, record EBITDA/PAT, ROCE ~26%, net debt -30%) on a multi-year T&D capex supercycle; FY27 guidance deliberately pruned to 20-22% revenue / ~11% EBITDA on geopolitical supply-chain caution, with >2yr order-book runway and capacity more-than-doubled.

1 one-line thesis: Best-ever year (rev +30%, record EBITDA/PAT, ROCE ~26%, net debt -30%) on a multi-year T&D capex supercycle; FY27 guidance deliberately pruned to 20-22% revenue / ~11% EBITDA on geopolitical supply-chain caution, with >2yr order-book runway and capacity more-than-doubled.
2 financial scorecard: One-offs: higher Q4 RM-cost % of revenue (commodity inflation + supply-chain delays); higher effective tax (timing).
3 guidance (incl. next quarter): FY27 revenue growth 20-22% (off larger INR 6,880 cr base); upside to 22%+ if geopolitics/supply chain stabilize.
FY27 EBITDA margin ~11% (down from 11.92%); steady-state 3yr target ~11-12%.
Q1/quarter-level: management refuses explicit Q1 guidance — says assume annualized rate; "first quarter will be stable." Bid ~INR 10,000 cr in Q1 already, awaiting results.
3-year vision: grow at ~20-25% CAGR; ROCE maintained ~25%; WC days toward sub-80.
4 order book & pipeline: Unexecuted order book INR 16,361 cr (incl. L1), up from 14,551 cr → >2 years revenue visibility.
Mix: ~90% Power T&D, ~10% other (civil/poles/railways); domestic ~50% / international ~50%.
International: Africa ~20% of order book; Bangladesh ~3-4% (Phase 1 done, Phase 2 to close in 3-4 months / project closure ~6 months).
Bid pipeline: India INR 80,000 cr-1,00,000 cr opportunity; international ~INR 50,000 cr — "not diminished." Targeting 10-12% market share. Bid ~INR 6,000 cr last quarter, ~INR 10,000 cr this quarter.
5 segment / subsidiary detail: Power T&D ~90% of revenue; substations <5% (smaller part).
Backward integration: own tower + conductor manufacturing — a differentiator most new competitors lack.
During FY26: completed seven 765 kV transmission projects in India; supplied >1,50,000 MT towers, 4,000 km conductors; entered Abu Dhabi, Tunisia, Djibouti, Botswana.
6 growth verticals / optionality: HVDC projects upcoming — part of multi-year cycle (>2,00,000 km lines to be added; >INR 9,00,000 cr investment outlook over 5 years).
State Electricity Boards moving to TBCB route — up to ~20% opportunity but Transrail currently only 3-4% SEB revenue; will participate selectively on risk matrix (none bid yet).
Multilateral-development-bank-funded international projects (preferred for risk management).
Construction-productivity capex (new INR 203 cr) to improve execution speed.
7 margins & cost dynamics: FY26 margin 11.92% within guided 11.5-12%; FY25 was 12.7% (mgmt insists not apples-to-apples — project mix/geography driven).
Q4 RM cost % rose sharply on commodity inflation + March supply-chain disruption.
~30-35% of contracts have price-variation (pass-through) clauses; rest fixed → margin exposure to commodity inflation.
Finance cost ~INR 210-220 cr; LC discounting + interest blended 8.5-9% (LC charges ~INR 40-50 cr); expects 50-100 bps reduction next year.
Claims best/one-of-best margin profile in T&D industry.
8 capex / expansion: IPO Phase-1 (~INR 520 cr Phase 1+2) completing by Q2 FY27: tower capacity 1,72,000 → 1,96,000 MTPA (more than doubled vs pre-expansion); conductor 24,000 → 49,500 km (doubling) by Q2/Q3 FY27.
New Board-approved (26-May-2026) INR 203 cr capex for FY27-28 — purely construction equipment + replacement of old machinery (NOT capacity).
CWIP rose to INR 65 cr (from INR 12 cr) — pending capitalization of tower/conductor expansion in Q2 FY27.
9 capital allocation: Net debt cut 30% to INR 274 cr (INR 181 cr ex-IPO funds); OCF doubled (~INR 816 cr from 415 cr).
WC days 81 (from 91), targeting sub-80; finance-cost/revenue improved 55 bps.
Trade acceptances ~INR 1,200 cr — to stay broadly flat; uses RXIL/VFS for credit.
10 risks & watch-items: Geopolitical / supply-chain disruption (Feb-Mar) deferring execution & inflating costs (fuel, shipping, insurance) — primary reason for pruned FY27 guidance.
Order-inflow miss (INR 8,520 cr vs ~10,000 cr target) — slippage risk into Q1 FY27.
Lumpy quarterly revenue (project lifecycle) — Q4 de-growth; not to be read QoQ.
Labour demand-supply tightness (managed via training/loyalty programs).
Right-of-way / forest / statutory clearance delays (client-side; covered by EOT).
Rising competition from road-EPC entrants into T&D (mgmt won't chase volume at lower margin).
Margin compression to ~11% (lowest profile since ~Mar'22 per an analyst).
11 management quality / tone: Confident, disciplined, candid. Consistently met/beat guidance (delivered 30% vs guided 25-27%). Emphasizes "fair and prudent" guidance, selective bidding, risk-managed (MDB-funded preference). Deflects QoQ scrutiny toward annual numbers; transparent on order-inflow miss and tax/finance-cost queries (some bookkeeping items deferred to IR). 42-year operating history cited repeatedly.
12 non-obvious takeaways: Q4 weakness is structural to project cycle (20 projects closed in Dec = high-margin closures front-loaded into H1), NOT demand loss — revenue "deferred not lost."
The ~11% margin guide bakes in commodity inflation AND the fact only ~35% of book has pass-through; upside is real if supply chain normalizes.
New INR 203 cr capex is construction-equipment-led — a tell that execution productivity (not capacity) is now the binding constraint on the 20-25% growth ambition.
Backward integration (own conductors/towers, full PQs) is the moat vs road-EPC new entrants.
SEB/TBCB is a large untapped optionality (~20% of pipeline) management is deliberately under-exposed to.
qoq change log: This quarter (Q4 FY26): FY26 closed +30% rev (beat 25-27% guide), record EBITDA INR 820 cr / PAT INR 421 cr; net debt -30% to INR 274 cr; OCF doubled; WC days 91→81; order book up to INR 16,361 cr; capacity more-than-doubled; new INR 203 cr construction-equipment capex approved; FY27 guide set at 20-22% rev / ~11% EBITDA / INR 10-11k cr inflow; INR 2/sh dividend. Order inflow missed (8,520 vs ~10,000 cr).

Next-quarter watch items: (1) Q1 FY27 order conversion from the ~INR 10,000 cr bid; (2) completion of IPO Phase-1 capex (tower 1,96,000 MTPA + conductor doubling) by Q2 FY27 and CWIP capitalization; (3) Bangladesh Phase-2 completion/closure (3-6 months); (4) whether supply-chain/geopolitical pressure eases (margin upside trigger); (5) finance-cost/LC reduction (50-100 bps); (6) whether order inflow recovers toward 10-11k cr run-rate.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
